prompt: Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm look, wide establishing composition. rationale: Cinematic still sets an authentic, atmospheric scene in a real space, capturing the tension between the pristine new appliance and the reality of the repair labor. The wide anamorphic framing allows for dramatic lighting that highlights the disparity between the promised efficiency and the physical weight of the hardware.
subject: a new modern refrigerator standing next to an old compressor and a canvas tool bag
core_thesis: The efficiency a new refrigerator buys is a $12.50-a-year saving, less than four hours of a repairer's time, so it can discount a replacement that a failure already justified but never be the reason for one.
core_conflict: The minimal real-world power savings versus the high upfront capital and labor cost of replacement.
composition: wide establishing composition, hero object off-centre
